message.content:
Based on the image provided, here are the answers to your questions:

1. **Green ENTRANCE (MASUK/ENTER) indicator with arrow icon at the right of row A?**
   **Yes.** There is a green tile on the far right of the top row (Row A) labeled "ENTER" with an arrow icon and "way in" text below it.

2. **EXIT (KELUAR) tile?**
   **Yes.** There is a grey/dark tile in Row B (between B-14 and the blue ramp) labeled "EXIT" with a door icon.

3. **Blue RAMP tile with down arrow?**
   **Yes.** There is a vertical blue tile to the right of the EXIT tile, containing a downward-pointing arrow and the text "RAMP" (or similar vertical text).

4. **Blue LIFT and violet WC tiles in row B?**
   **No.** In this view, I see the EXIT tile and the RAMP tile in that section of Row B. I do not see any tiles specifically labeled "LIFT" or "WC" (and certainly not in violet/purple color). The visible non-parking slots are the grey EXIT tile and the blue RAMP tile.
